identity_summary: A night-shift line cook who keeps every promise he makes to his daughter, and no promise he makes to himself.
social_context: Raised by a grandmother, now the steady adult in his household.
emotional_wound: He was told he was not the reliable one and has spent years proving it.
mistaken_belief: Being needed is the same thing as being loved.
behavior_under_pressure: Goes quiet, works faster, and agrees to more than he can carry.
appearance_traits: Tall, broad shoulders, worn hands, close-cropped hair.
relevant_background_history: Left school at seventeen to cover rent.
Cooked his way up from dishwashing in the same kitchen.
competence: Reads a crowded kitchen and reorders the line before it backs up.
fears: That his daughter will learn to expect less from him.
beliefs: A man is what he shows up for on the days he is tired.
contradictions: Preaches rest and never takes any.
habits: Wipes the counter before answering a hard question.

wants.external: Keep the job that covers the rent.
wants.internal: Be someone his daughter can count on out loud.

voice.rhythm: Short flat sentences, one beat per thought.
voice.vocabulary: Kitchen words, no flourish, no profanity in front of family.
voice.restraint: Answers fewer questions than he is asked.

identity_visual.face: Long face, tired eyes, faint scar above the left brow.
identity_visual.age: Thirties, reads older under fluorescent light.
identity_visual.hair: Close-cropped black hair, greying at the temples.
wardrobe_rules: Workwear only: dark button shirt, sleeves rolled.
No jewellery except a plain wedding band on a chain.
continuity_constraints: Sleeves never rolled above the elbow.
identity_visual.prompt_block: Marcus Bell, tall line cook in his thirties, long tired face, close-cropped greying hair, faint left brow scar, dark button shirt with sleeves rolled to the forearm.
